## Type of change

<!-- mark with x -->
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / code-quality improvement (no behaviour change)
- [ ] CI / tooling change

## Checklist

- [ ] All 4 gates pass locally: `npm run lint`, `typecheck`, `test`, `build`
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (or rationale why not)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `README.md`, or `CHANGELOG.md` "Unreleased")
- [ ] No new `eslint-disable` without inline justification comment
- [ ] No new dependencies without an ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] Conventional commit message (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`, `test:`)
- [ ] If touching a tool, the tool's `docs/tools/<name>.md` is in sync
